part.name: Exploded hot-end / extruder component set
part.description: Nine disconnected STEP solids arranged as an exploded mechanical hot-end or extrusion-head component set. The set includes two large body or heat-management blocks, a mounting bracket, a tubular heat break, two clamp/heater blocks, and three threaded nozzle or fitting components. Component identities and functions are semantic inferences; solid IDs, face IDs, surface types, axes, radii, and bounding boxes are deterministic CadQuery observations.
part.symmetry_note: Several components have bilateral symmetry and repeated paired bores. SOLID 1 has a linear stack of heat-dissipation fins. SOLIDs 6, 7, and 8 are coaxial threaded components with sixfold hexagonal wrench regions. The nine solids are spatially separated and appear to be distinct functional components or alternative nozzle/fitting variants rather than disconnected fragments of one monolithic body.

semantic_orientation.description: The component set is displayed in an exploded layout rather than an assembled operating pose. CAD +Z is consistently the principal height direction of the tall blocks, tubular heat break, and threaded nozzle variants, and is interpreted as semantic top. Faces near y=0 on the large upper-row bodies appear to be the most presentation-facing surfaces and are interpreted as the front.
